say:1:1030204901:0.text: My stubborn girlfriend doesn't understand what I'm trying to do.
say:1:1030204901:0.source_cn: 我那固执的女朋友，根本不能理解我的用心。
say:1:1030204901:0.male: My stubborn girlfriend doesn't understand what I'm trying to do.

say:2:1030204902:0.text: Working for Lord Franz is a great opportunity. Why can't she see that?
say:2:1030204902:0.source_cn: 为弗朗茨工作是多有钱途的事，为什么她不能理解呢？

say:4:1030204904:0.text: She has left me to grow wheat in Northville...
say:4:1030204904:0.source_cn: 她已经离开我，跑去北村继续耕种小麦了……
say:4:1030204904:0.male: She has left me to grow wheat in Northville...

say:5:1030204905:0.text: I know growing wheat in Ryeham is tradition, but there's nothing wrong with embracing changes.
say:5:1030204905:0.source_cn: 确实，种麦是金穗村的传统，但迎接变化也没什么不好。
